Package com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.camera

Class OrbitCamera

java.lang.Object
com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.camera.OrbitCamera
All Implemented Interfaces:
processing.core.PConstants
public class OrbitCamera extends Object implements processing.core.PConstants
Scene-space quaternion orbit camera provided as a native ziviDomeLive service.

Unlike MouseControlledCamera (which drives the Standard View through pg.camera(...)), OrbitCamera transforms the scene modelview directly inside sceneRender. Because it operates in scene space, the same camera works identically across every projection (fisheye, equirectangular, cubemap and standard) and never touches the dome parameters (yaw / pitch / roll / fov) articulated by the ControlManager.

Typical usage inside a Scene:

 public void sceneRender(PGraphicsOpenGL pg) {
     pg.pushMatrix();
     parent.getSceneCamera().apply(pg); // move through space
     // ... draw scene content ...
     pg.popMatrix();
 }

Rotations use unit quaternions (gimbal-lock free) and every target, orientation and distance change is smoothly interpolated (SLERP/LERP) for fluid motion. Mouse handling is built in: drag to orbit, wheel to fly in/out.

    • setCollapseGuard

      public void setCollapseGuard(float guard)
      Sets a collapse-guard dead zone around distance 0. When positive, the orbit distance can never enter (-guard, +guard) nor flip sign through zero, which prevents the view from collapsing when the allowed distance range spans both negative and positive values. Set to 0 to disable.
      Parameters:
      guard - half-width of the forbidden zone around zero (>= 0)

    • setLerpFactor

      public void setLerpFactor(float lerpFactor)
      Sets the interpolation amount per frame (0..1). Higher is snappier.
      Parameters:
      lerpFactor - easing factor
